bill_text.text_with_changes:
A bill for an act relating to game and fish; providing for free angling, deer, and small game licenses to residents age 65 or over; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97A.441, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97A.441, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

[+Subd. 11.+]

[+Angling and taking deer and small game; age 65 or older.+]

[+(a) A person authorized to issue licenses must issue, without a fee, to a resident who is age 65 or older: +]

[+(1) a permanent license to take fish by angling; +]

[+(2) an annual license to take deer by firearms or by archery; and +]

[+(3) an annual license to take small game. +]

[+(b) A driver's license or Minnesota identification card serves as satisfactory evidence to obtain a license under this subdivision at all agent locations. +]
bill_text.plain_text:
A bill for an act relating to game and fish; providing for free angling, deer, and small game licenses to residents age 65 or over; amending Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97A.441, by adding a subdivision.

BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF MINNESOTA:

Section 1.
Minnesota Statutes 2024, section 97A.441, is amended by adding a subdivision to read:

Subd. 11.

Angling and taking deer and small game; age 65 or older.

(a) A person authorized to issue licenses must issue, without a fee, to a resident who is age 65 or older:

(1) a permanent license to take fish by angling;

(2) an annual license to take deer by firearms or by archery; and

(3) an annual license to take small game.

(b) A driver's license or Minnesota identification card serves as satisfactory evidence to obtain a license under this subdivision at all agent locations.
